title: T47 skills: agent-core requirement as a range, not a stale pin (0.2.1.post1)
head: t47-skills-post1
body:
## What

`skills`' `pyproject.toml` pinned its runtime requirement on `agent-core`
to an exact version, `agent-core==0.4.0`. That's now a range with a floor
and a ceiling: `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8`. The `[tool.uv.sources]` entry for
this repo's own dev/test env still points at the vendored `agent-core`
0.4.0 wheel, so skills' own tests keep running against the floor version.
Version 0.2.1 -> 0.2.1.post1 everywhere it's asserted (`pyproject.toml`;
`uv.lock` via `uv lock --offline`). No code change. New test:
`tests/test_wheel_metadata.py` builds the wheel and asserts its METADATA
`Requires-Dist` for `agent-core` is exactly `agent-core<0.8,>=0.4.0`
(packaging's normalized order), never an `==` pin, and that the wheel
filename carries `0.2.1.post1`.

## Why

T47 (decisions #207, #210, #222). skills 0.2.1 is playbooks 0.2.4's other
pinned runtime dependency and is not vendored in agent-core; it carries the
same stale `agent-core==0.4.0` pin as connectors and playbooks did (proof:
`playbooks-024`'s own resolution proof, `uv lock --offline` against a real
agent-core fails over `skills`, not over playbooks' own range -- see that
PR's body). Decision #222 (orchestrator, provisional): same source fix, cut
as a PEP 440 **post**-release (`0.2.1.post1`, metadata only -- `0.2.2`
already exists as a later, separate release, so a normal patch bump would
sort ahead of it and confuse the ordering) from the exact 0.2.1 commit
(`1df9673`) on a `release/0.2` branch. No code change, so the rig's
behavior is unchanged. skills `main`'s own exact `agent-core==0.7.22` pin is
the same bug, one layer further along; that forward-port is queued
separately and is out of scope here. Once this lands, playbooks 0.2.4 pins
`skills==0.2.1.post1` instead of `skills==0.2.1` (companion PR), and
agent-core vendors and declares all three wheels (connectors 0.5.1,
playbooks 0.2.4, skills 0.2.1.post1).

## Resolution proof

Scratch-only, nothing committed here. Verified red on the pre-fix 0.2.1
commit: built the wheel from a clean checkout of `1df9673` with this PR's
own `tests/test_wheel_metadata.py` copied in -- both assertions fail
(`agent-core==0.4.0` instead of the range; wheel name
`skills-0.2.1-py3-none-any.whl` instead of the `0.2.1.post1` prefix). The
full three-wheel resolution proof (connectors 0.5.1 + playbooks 0.2.4 +
this skills 0.2.1.post1, built into an `agent-core` `origin/main` copy) is
reported in the T47 agent-core PR, not here.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

```
uv lock --offline -> Resolved 35 packages, Updated skills v0.2.1 -> v0.2.1.post1
uv sync --locked --offline -> Installed 29 packages
uv run --no-sync pytest -q -> 13 passed
uv run --no-sync ruff check . -> All checks passed!
uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src -> Success: no issues found in 2 source files
```

`ruff format --check` is not a CI step in this repo (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`
runs `ruff check .` only, no format step).

## Mutation check

- Mutant: revert `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8` back to `agent-core==0.4.0` in
  `pyproject.toml`. Killed by
  `tests/test_wheel_metadata.py::test_wheel_declares_agent_core_as_a_range_not_a_pin`
  (built wheel's `Requires-Dist` is `agent-core==0.4.0`, fails the
  `<0.8,>=0.4.0` assertion). Verified red on the pre-fix 0.2.1 commit
  (`1df9673`): both wheel-metadata tests fail (`2 failed`).
- Mutant: drop the ceiling, `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8` -> `agent-core>=0.4.0`.
  Killed by the same test (`str(specifier) == "<0.8,>=0.4.0"` is an exact
  match, not a substring/contains check, so a missing ceiling fails it
  too).
